description: Write (create or overwrite) a workspace-relative file. Content is capped at 256 KiB. Optional create_dirs=true mkdir -p's the parent chain. Returns a structured error envelope on path_escape, not_found (missing parent), too_large, or io.
name: file_write

content.description: File content. May be empty (truncates the target to 0 bytes).

create_dirs.description: If true, mkdir -p the parent chain. Default false.
